from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485747/attempts/18dbe85446804b4a9d8265837008f502/system/state/workspace/programs/task-dec04905.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    # Restore the obscured repeating 5-cell color sequence; preserve the frame.
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cycle = [3, 5, 7, 9, 1]
    for r, row in enumerate(out):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != 0:
                continue
            if r < 2:
                row[c] = 1
            elif r == 2:
                row[c] = 4
            elif c < 2:
                row[c] = 1
            else:
                # The visible sequence on each row anchors the phase.
                anchors = [(j, x) for j, x in enumerate(row) if x in cycle]
                j, x = min(anchors, key=lambda pair: abs(pair[0] - c))
                row[c] = cycle[(cycle.index(x) + c - j) % len(cycle)]
    return out
''')
print(p, p.stat().st_size)
